summary: The Java model (Geography/src/geography/) implements a walking-only evacuation ABM: residents start at real Portland campsite-report points, accrue county-uniform hourly PM2.5 exposure while outside, depart either by a bright-line latch (PM2.5 >= 55.5 AND a shelter open) or, with the Phase-E layer on, by an hourly logistic hazard u = alpha + bRisk(1+gammaVuln*vuln)z_R + wOfficial*1{open} + sigmaTheta*thetaZ - c_i; they walk Dijkstra shortest paths to shelters chosen either omnisciently-nearest (L0) or by utility V_j = -betaT*walkTime + betaS*ln(capacity) under L1 locations-only information. Barriers are pet policy and adults-only gates at the door, plus log-odds departure costs for belongings/pet/dependents and a group-pace slowdown for dependents. No transport assistance of any kind exists (ABSENT — walking is the only mode). Arrival at a shelter is the study endpoint; refused residents wait at the refusing door and retry; capacity is hard, monotone (no departures), with an optional mobility-only triage reserve (arm D). Exposure accounting keeps three deliberately separated quantities: concentration-time integral, activity-weighted inhaled dose (1.62/0.61 m3/h walking/resting — the 0.61 is an admitted open defect, not in its EPA source), and a health-risk multiplier hardwired to 1.0. Real 2020 opening dates (OCC 09-10, CJ 09-11, both to 09-19) gate departure and admission. Scenario-E adds scaled counterfactual smoke and scheduled street-closure waves with an unsourced push-through/stuck rule. Provenance: registry variables.csv has 55 rows — evidence census M=15, L=11, A=29, C=0, F=0 (script-verified). Classifying the behavioral/exposure coefficients: ~11 are LOCAL (Portland/Multnomah measurements: age bands, sex, mobility marginal, chronic-physical, awareness 0.356, attempt share 0.385, dependents 0.0044, opening dates, smoke field, start locations, the unconfirmed 99-bed capacity), ~10 are TRANSFERRED (walking-speed tables, asthma/COPD prevalences from Minnesota EHR, COPD speed delta, EPA inhalation rates, pet prevalence from LA County, group-speed delta, barrier-cost anchors, the EPA threshold convention, Boyce impaired speeds, the CASPEH age-gradient ratio), and ~15 are ASSUMED (belongings midpoint, all six hazard coefficients, outreach rate, both choice-utility weights, all three blockage parameters, the three susceptibility placeholders pinned 1.0, plus two numerical guards). Four assumptions are flagged blocking: A-04, A-09, A-12, A-16. Registry-vs-code contradictions found: A-05 still claims freeways are unfiltered (the code filters them), A-15 still claims no breathing rate is modelled (inhaled dose is implemented), A-12 remains blocking though V29 awareness is implemented in E arms, all of V29–V51 carry status "specified" though the mechanisms are present in code, and a GisAgent comment about the EFH primary is stale against the registry's 2026-08-04 re-read.

items.name: Awareness (V29 pAwareInit)
items.detail: Bernoulli(pAwareInit) drawn per resident at build by ELayerSampler (fixed draw order aware->belongings->pet->dependents->theta); unaware residents start in State.UNAWARE and sit at the encampment accruing exposure. Default 1.0 (legacy byte-identity); sourced value 0.356 = 26/73 from Hines et al. 2021 'Stories from the Outside' (N=73 Portland unhoused adults, THIS event), Wilson CI 0.25-0.47. Class L, LOCAL. Conversion channel: outreach only, hourly Bernoulli(lambdaOutreachPerDay/24) on the per-agent decision stream; lambda default 0.0, swept 0-0.2/day, UNSOURCED (A-31, ASSUMED).

items.name: Departure decision — legacy latch
items.detail: Every tick while PRE_EVAC: depart iff C(t) >= evacuationThresholdUgM3 (default 55.5 ug/m3, EPA 'Unhealthy' AQI breakpoint lower bound, D9 — a convention, TRANSFERRED, class L) AND anyShelterOpen (A-02 mitigation). Runs verbatim when decision layer off or enableHazardDeparture=0 (the R3 null).

items.name: Departure decision — Phase-E logistic hazard (V35-V41)
items.detail: Hourly, gated on an open shelter: u = alphaHazard + bRisk*(1+(vulnerable?gammaVuln:0))*z_R + wOfficial*1{open} + sigmaTheta*thetaZ - c_i; p=1/(1+exp(-u)); depart iff open && decisionRng<p. z_R = cumulative unhealthy-exposure DAYS with exponential decay: z_R <- z_R*2^(-1/riskHalfLifeH) + 1{c>=55.5}/24 (form from Castillo 2023, magnitude unsourced). Coefficients (batch defaults / baseline-real): alphaHazard -8.0 provisional pending E9 calibration (A-30, ASSUMED); bRisk 0.4 swept 0.25-0.55 (ASSUMED, class A); wOfficial 1.1 swept 0.6-1.7 (ASSUMED, anchored to Tanim 2022 pooled OR 4.21 -> ln 1.44); gammaVuln 0/0.25 swept 0-0.5 (ASSUMED, sign anchor Coughlan 2022 — citation corrected from nonexistent 'Evers'); sigmaTheta 0/1.0 swept 0.5-1.5 (ASSUMED, Kincade variance-ratio anchor); riskHalfLifeH 48 swept 12-72; vulnerable = copd|asthma|age>=65|mobilityLimited.

items.name: Barrier cost c_i (V40)
items.detail: Precomputed at setDecisionLayer: c_i = barrierBelongings*heavy + barrierPet*pet*1{world default refuses pets} + barrierDependents*dependents; enters the hazard negatively (suppresses/delays departure; Wachinger risk-perception-paradox constraint). Baseline-real value 0.26 per barrier, swept 0.10-0.42 (anchors from Tanim 2022 meta-analysis — TRANSFERRED anchors, value choice within bracket). Never a walking-speed penalty (Bastien 2005 negative result).

items.name: Destination choice — L0 omniscient (legacy)
items.detail: chooseNetworkNearestShelter: among operating, open, reachable shelters with live hasSpaceFor(priority), pick minimum street-network distance from currentNodeId (Dijkstra tree per shelter, geodesic edge weights); ties broken by context iteration order. Post-refusal re-plans start from the refusing shelter's node (A-17), never the encampment.

items.name: Destination choice — L1 utility (V42/V43)
items.detail: chooseShelterByUtility: V_j = -betaTravelTime*(distM/(ownSpeed*3600)) + betaCapacityPrior*ln(max(1,cap_j)) over operating/open/reachable sites NOT in believedFull; deliberately NO live-occupancy filter (fullness discovered at the door); uncapped sites use ln-cap 10000; exact ties -> lexicographically smallest shelter id. betaT 1.0, betaS 0 default / 0.2 baseline-real, swept 1-2 orders of magnitude — both ASSUMED (A-32; impedance dominance verified in Cheng 2008, the ln(capacity) size-prior form is a declared stand-in). betaS=0 reduces to nearest-reachable.

items.name: Barrier — pet policy gate (V32/A-29)
items.detail: At the door: hasPet && !petAdmittedAt(shelter) -> policy refusal (counted separately via recordPolicyRefusal). Per-site pet_intake from the _elayer CSV variant when shelterPolicyVariant=1 (4 of 48 present-day facilities record admit, 422 beds); unrecorded sites take run-wide petPolicyDefault (1=admit inert default; baseline-real arms set 0=refuse, the conservative A-29 reading — 48.1% of owners ever turned away, Henwood 2020). Prevalence pHasPet 0.117 (Henwood 2020, LA County counts — class L, TRANSFERRED; floor 0.055 Cronley 2009).

items.name: Barrier — adults-only gate (V33)
items.detail: hasDependents && shelter.isAdultsOnly() -> policy refusal at the door. adults_only read from an optional CSV column; PORT_MAP notes no committed shelter file carries it, so the gate is currently exercised only via the departure-cost and group-speed channels. Prevalence pHasDependents 0.0044 = 30/6831 (HUD 2025 PIT CoC OR-501 — class M, LOCAL; adults-only 2020 intake verified via Street Roots). Dependents also slow the group: v = max(0.40, v - groupSpeedDeltaMps), delta sourced 0.06 m/s swept 0.04-0.08 (Moussaid 2010 pedestrian-group experiments — class L, TRANSFERRED); sampled individual speed never mutated.

items.name: Barrier — heavy belongings (V31)
items.detail: Departure-cost channel only (enters c_i); explicitly never a speed penalty. Prevalence 0.284 = declared midpoint (A-27, ASSUMED) of a sourced bracket: floor 0.108 (Ozarks 2024 unsheltered PIT N=138), ceiling 0.42-0.46 (CASPEH 2023 / Herring 2020); swept over the full bracket.

items.name: Barrier — mobility limitation (V20)
items.detail: Three mechanical roles: (1) speed REPLACEMENT with Boyce 1999 ambulant-impaired N(0.95,0.32) m/s (TRANSFERRED, verified-in-secondary via Tinaburri 2018 — primary paywalled); (2) sole priority-admission criterion under arm D triage; (3) +1.0 penalty in the Scenario-E push threshold. Prevalence: local marginal 0.192 (2019 Multnomah PIT 391/2037, LOWER BOUND — LOCAL, class M) with age-gradient ratio ~2.29 donor-imputed from CASPEH California (TRANSFERRED component, A-18): P=0.152163 under 55 / 0.347802 at 55+. All limited residents get the FASTEST impaired category (A-19, conservative).

items.name: Transportation assistance
items.detail: No transport mechanism of any kind exists: no bus, vehicle, shuttle, ride, or assisted-movement code path anywhere in Geography/src (grep for transport|bus|transit|vehicle|ride|drive|car returns only comments and @Override noise). Walking on the street graph is the only movement mode; step length = v*60*minutesPerTick metres of geodesic arc per tick.

items.name: Smoke input — spatial structure (V5)
items.detail: County-uniform hourly PM2.5: per-hour mean over ALL in-county Multnomah AQS monitors/POCs (EPA AQS parameter 88502), applied uniformly in space — with 2 in-county regulatory monitors any interpolant would 'fit two points' (A-01). Missing hours stay NaN; lookups beyond data/gaps return 0.0 and increment outOfRangeLookups (manifest-reported). Observed peak 562.7 ug/m3 (2-monitor mean). Scenario-E: smokeSeriesCode selects synthetic severe v1 (embedded 1.75x, peak 984.75) or worst-case v2 (4.436x, peak 2496.1, Canberra Florey-anchored, A-33); smokeScale multiplies every real hourly value once at construction. LOCAL measured data (class M) for series 0; declared counterfactual for 1/2.

items.name: Exposure and inhaled-dose accounting (V6/V7/V8/V25)
items.detail: Three deliberately separated quantities, accrued every tick while state != SHELTERED (arrival is the study endpoint and stops accrual forever): (1) exposureUgM3h += C*dt (physics of the air); (2) inhaledDoseUg += C*IR(activity)*dt with IR = 1.62 m3/h walking / 0.61 resting — activity only, never diagnosis (V25, EPA Exposure Factors Handbook 2011, TRANSFERRED; registry records the 2026-08-04 primary re-read: walking 1.62 CONFIRMED as the moderate-intensity ages-31-41 cell, resting 0.61 IS NOT IN THE SOURCE — open defect D16, unfixed, sweep should widen to ~0.25-0.80); (3) healthRiskMultiplier hardwired 1.0 for everyone (no defensible susceptibility coefficient exists; A-09/A-22). vweUgM3h = C*RR_age*RR_com*dt with both RRs pinned 1.0 (V2/V4/V7 placeholders — the slide-cited 1.45/1.80 are unsourced/nonexistent). hoursAboveUnhealthy counts dt where C > 55.5 (strict >; the z_R cue uses >=, deliberate). airVolumeBreathedM3 exported so dose decomposes. Stuck Scenario-E residents breathe at resting rate.

items.name: Capacity / refusal / re-entry mechanics (V12, A-17, A-21)
items.detail: admit() increments occupancy while occupancy < capacity (null capacity = unlimited standby); full -> refusedCount++ and the resident REMAINS at the refusing shelter's street node, re-planning from there next tick (A-17, Finding A — never walks back to the encampment). Arm D: reservedForPriority = floor(capacity*triageReserveFraction) held for mobility-limited arrivals; non-priority see capacity-reserve; 0 = FCFS bit-identical. L0 retry cap MAX_RETARGETS=8 (reset on re-entry); L1 uncapped, bounded by the monotone believedFull set (refusals never expire — occupancy is monotone, no shelter departures modelled, A-07). REFUSED_ALL_FULL is re-evaluated every tick and non-terminal (a later opening re-activates the resident); UNREACHABLE is terminal. Capacity 99/site for 2020 is newsroom-sourced, unconfirmed — blocking A-04. LOCAL record, class A.

items.name: Shelter opening dates (V23)
items.detail: Real dates from the shelter CSV: OCC opened 2020-09-10, CJ 2020-09-11, both closed 2020-09-19 (verified in shelters_2020-09.csv rows 2-3; MSCC is a standby site). Gate active only when respectShelterOpeningDates=1: openTick = 00:00 local on the opened date (earliest defensible reading, A-20 — understates pre-opening exposure), closeTick = start of day AFTER the closed date (+1 day offset). Gate off = always open (the A-02 counterfactual, runtime-warned). 2026 arm files carry opened=2020-09-07 (open from sim start). LOCAL, class M.

items.name: Scenario-E closures and push-through (V48-V51)
items.detail: Constructed closure schedules (A-34 — no Portland-core 2020 record exists) applied as one-shot waves at FIRST_PRIORITY; blocked edges leave the Dijkstra relaxation; every shelter tree recomputed once per wave; connectivity check guarantees no shelter isolated. Mid-walk agents re-scan their remaining node chain once per wave: push iff thetaScaled >= pushThetaThreshold + kPush*(barrierCost + mobilityPenalty) — coefficients UNSOURCED (A-35), aggregate disciplined against the 55-75% fire-incident continue band (Wood 1972/Bryan 1977/Jin 1997, all indoor smoke — transferability itself assumed). Push -> Bernoulli(pStuck=0.3, ASSUMED, no analog anywhere) -> stuckDelayH=3h delay at resting ventilation (ASSUMED, vehicular-only anchors); reroute -> re-plan from last reached node. All defaults inert without a closure wave. PORT_MAP additionally reports pushThetaThreshold executed as 0.0 in archived runs (batch parser zeroes negative 'number' constants — inert defect).

items.name: Walking speed provenance (V10/V18/V19/V24/V27)
items.detail: Heterogeneity on: per-agent truncated normal N(mu, 0.13*mu) on [0.40,2.20] m/s; mu from Bohannon & Williams Andrews 2011 age-decade-by-sex grand means (men 1.358..0.968, women 1.341..0.943 — TRANSFERRED, 41 studies n=23,111); CV 0.13 from Bohannon 1997 (TRANSFERRED); COPD subtracts 0.19 m/s additively (Buekers 2024 meta-analysis, -0.28..-0.11 CI, evidence rated LOW — TRANSFERRED, class L); mobility-limited replaced by Boyce N(0.95,0.32) with COPD delta deliberately NOT stacked. Age bands {0.527,0.423,0.050} over 18-44/45-64/65+ from Pathways 2026 Multnomah N=541 pooled sample (LOCAL, class M, supersedes 2019 PIT); sex weights {0.68432,0.29271,0.02297} from 2019 Multnomah PIT (LOCAL); OTHER sex takes the mean of the two columns. Bounds/ceiling (0.40/2.20; age cap 90) are ASSUMED numerical guards, verified inert. Heterogeneity off: run-wide 1.30 m/s (below 10 of 12 Bohannon 1997 cells).

items.name: Respiratory/chronic prevalences (V21a/V21b/V22)
items.detail: asthma ~ Bernoulli(0.15), copd ~ Bernoulli(0.105) — Zellmer 2025 Minnesota EHR n=20,139 recent-homelessness (TRANSFERRED, class L; no local estimate exists at all; ACS/BRFSS/NHIS deliberately rejected — sampling frames exclude unsheltered people); sampled independent of age (evidence-based: Brown 2017 26.3% at 50+ vs CASPEH 25% overall). Asthma has NO speed and NO dose effect (D-3, A-23); COPD has the one speed effect; both enter the hazard's vulnerable flag. chronicPhysical ~ Bernoulli(0.391) Pathways 2026 (LOCAL, class M) — reporting stratum only. Vulnerable reporting union: age55+|mobility|asthma|copd|chronicPhysical, explicitly a stratum not a risk score.

items.name: Parameter-provenance bucket counts
items.detail: Registry evidence-class census over all 55 variable rows (script-verified): M=15, L=11, A=29, C=0, F=0; statuses: implemented=28, specified=23, placeholder=3 (V7/V2/V4), deprecated=1 (V-ARRIVAL). My behavioral/exposure-coefficient bucket classification (criteria: inputs that shape behavior or exposure, excluding pure infrastructure/derived outputs): LOCAL=11 (V18 age, V19 sex, V20 mobility marginal, V22 chronic, V29 aware 0.356, V30 attempt 0.385, V33 dependents 0.0044, V23 opening dates, V5 smoke field, V-STARTLOC start locations [2025-26 temporal proxy, A-03], V12 capacity 99 [local newsroom, unconfirmed, blocking A-04]); TRANSFERRED=10 (V10+Bohannon tables+CV+Boyce impaired speeds, V21a asthma MN, V21b COPD MN, V24 COPD delta, V25 inhalation rates, V32 pet LA, V34 group delta, V40 barrier anchors, V-EVAC 55.5 convention, V20's CASPEH age-gradient ratio); ASSUMED=15 (V31 belongings midpoint, V35 sigmaTheta, V36 bRisk+halfLife, V37 wOfficial, V38 alphaHazard, V39 gammaVuln, V41 outreach, V43 betaT+betaS, V49 pStuck, V50 stuckDelayH, V51 threshold+kPush, V2/V4/V7 weights pinned 1.0, V27 speed bounds, V28 age ceiling). Every hazard-departure coefficient and every blockage coefficient is ASSUMED; every awareness/demographic marginal except pets and belongings is LOCAL.

items.name: Blocking assumption A-04
items.detail: 'Each operating shelter has a nightly capacity of 99' — newsroom-sourced, unconfirmed by a primary agency document; now the single largest driver of the headline result (number sheltered = total capacity exactly). Status: blocking. Plan: confirm against a primary source and sweep capacity while refusal counts are quoted.

items.name: Blocking assumption A-09
items.detail: 'Susceptibility weights are 1.0 so the Exposure Burden Index equals raw exposure' — the slide-cited RRs could not be verified and the multiplicative formulation is a category error. Status: blocking. Plan: report stratified exposure as primary; sweep weights 1.0-2.5 only as a labelled equivalent-dose sensitivity.

items.name: Blocking assumption A-12
items.detail: 'All residents know the shelters exist and where they are' — placeholder contradicted by the local record (65% never heard of the shelters). Status: blocking. Plan: replace with awareness Bernoulli 0.35, sweep 0.25-0.45. NOTE: exactly this replacement is implemented (V29/ELayerSampler/UNAWARE state) for decision-layer arms, but the row has not been retired — it remains true only of legacy arms.

items.name: Blocking assumption A-16
items.detail: 'Agent execution order within a tick does not affect outcomes' — true only while capacity never binds; the seed-driven per-tick shuffle decides who gets the last bed at production scale. Status: blocking. Plan: order-independent two-phase admission before any run with more agents than beds, then confirm seed-order invariance.

items.name: Contradiction: A-05 vs freeway filter
items.detail: assumptions.csv A-05 (status active) states freeway/ramp segments are 'not yet filtered from the pedestrian graph' — but ContextCreator excludes RLIS TYPE {1110,1120,1121,1122,1123} from graph AND display (U-27), and registry row V26 records the same filter as status=implemented. The assumption row is stale; the code contradicts it.

items.name: Contradiction: A-15 vs inhaled dose
items.detail: assumptions.csv A-15 (status active) states 'No breathing rate or particle deposition is modelled, so the quantity is a time-integrated concentration and not a mass inhaled' — but GisAgent implements the ventilation-rate inhaled-dose chain (inhaledDoseUg += C*IR(activity)*dt) and registry V25 records it as implemented. True for V6 as headline metric; the categorical 'no breathing rate is modelled' statement is contradicted by the code.

items.name: Mismatch: V29-V51 status 'specified' vs implemented code
items.detail: All 23 Phase-E/Scenario-E registry rows (V29-V51) carry status='specified', yet the mechanisms are present and executable in the code I read (ELayerSampler, GisAgent hazard/choosers/blockage logic, StreetNetwork closures, ContextCreator wiring) and each row's implementation column names those real code paths. Conservative labeling or a stale status field — either way the registry status does not match the code state.

items.name: Stale code comment: EFH primary re-read
items.detail: GisAgent's INHALATION_WALKING_M3H comment claims 'the EFH table cell was not re-read from the primary during this implementation' — but registry V25 records 'RE-READ FROM PRIMARY 2026-08-04, SPLIT RESULT' (walking confirmed, resting 0.61 absent from Table 6-2, open defect D16). The comment predates the citation sweep and now understates what is known (in both directions).

items.name: V30 pAttemptGivenAware
items.detail: 0.385 = 10/26 (same Hines 2021 survey, LOCAL, class L) — consumed only as the E9 calibration target for alphaHazard; the registry states 'not read by any code path' and no code reads it (grep of GisAgent/ContextCreator shows only alphaHazard's default -8.0 chosen so implied attempt share matches 0.356*0.385=0.137).

items.name: Movement mechanics
items.detail: Deterministic: stepLengthM = v*60*minutesPerTick geodesic metres per tick along the Dijkstra polyline (Karney/GeographicLib WGS84, not haversine); partial segments via Geodesic.Direct; snapGapM books the real off-network metres from encampment to first waypoint; plannedRouteM accumulates every planned leg for the A-17 walked-vs-planned QC check. Graph: undirected (A-06), corrupt-node-ID correction with NODE_SITE_TOLERANCE 100 m / REATTACH 10 m, zero RNG anywhere in routing.

items.name: Output/equity accounting (V14)
items.detail: OutcomeLogger exports 59-column agents.csv, 12-column shelters.csv (refused_count includes policy refusals; policy_refused the auditable subset), and hand-assembled simulation.json with the 41-name parameter manifest, exposure stats and Gini (full O(n^2) mean-absolute-difference, 0 if n==0 or mu==0) for both raw exposure and the weighted index, plus 7-strata stratified_exposure. Column count and manifest structure REPORTED from PORT_MAP; gini formula, vulnerable predicate, and header fragments directly verified.

gaps: OutcomeLogger.java read only in targeted windows (header fragment, vulnerable predicate, gini, stratified marker), not all 817 lines — the 59-column claim and full simulation.json key order are REPORTED from PORT_MAP.md:513-573, not independently re-verified line-by-line.
PORT_MAP.md lines 596-753 (validation assets / golden runs / risk register tail) not read — the 41-parameter surface spec sections (1-5) were read in full.

Batch parameter XML files were not opened; baseline-real values (e.g. gammaVuln 0.25, barrier costs 0.26, sigmaTheta 1.0) are taken from PORT_MAP.md:355-373 and registry text, consistent with ContextCreator defaults but not verified against the actual batch files.

The claim that pushThetaThreshold executed as 0.0 in archived runs (Repast zeroing negative 'number' constants) is REPORTED (PORT_MAP.md:389 and memory note); the archived run manifests were not inspected.
The E9 calibration of alphaHazard is registered as pending (A-30); whether a fitted value now exists elsewhere in docs/ was not checked — the code default is -8.0 (ContextCreator.java:282).
The websim TypeScript port itself was not audited for mechanism fidelity (task scoped to the certified Java model plus PORT_MAP as spec); nor were scripts/ analysis tools.

Shelter CSVs for arms B/C/D and _elayer variants were not opened row-by-row; capacities (6,842 etc.) and the 4-of-48 pet-admit sites are taken from code comments, registry A-29, and PORT_MAP (REPORTED).
